### 15:45Z - Approximate waypoint requirement

- Ruling: Use the submitted public city or coverage area as the approximate waypoint when exact public location data is unavailable. Label it as a waypoint, not a business address, and do not offer business directions or put the business name into the area query. Private street addresses, Place IDs, and coordinate URLs are never used; without a safe public area there is no map.
